item.title: Two wanted after Augusta victim lured from ATM in Saturday robbery
item.description: Two suspects wanted in a Saturday armed robbery are believed to have slipped away as a SWAT team was responding to a home connected to the case, according to investigators. The post Two wanted after Augusta victim lured from ATM in Saturday robbery appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Hephzibah mom caught on video abusing 9-year-old daughter
item.description: A Hephzibah mother of five who was caught on video beating and screaming at her 9-year-old daughter has been charged with child cruelty, authorities said. The post Hephzibah mom caught on video abusing 9-year-old daughter appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: USCA and Aiken Tech to host series of events honoring Martin Luther King Jr.
item.description: The University of South Carolina Aiken and Aiken Technical College will host a series of events in January honoring the life and legacy of the Rev. item.title: RCSS enters busy back half of January with meetings and public hearings
item.description: The Richmond County School System is heading into a busy back half of January as board members, district staff, and families move through a series of meetings and public hearings tied to the district’s long-range facilities master plan. The post RCSS enters busy back half of January with meetings and public hearings appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Chick-fil-A opens new drive-thru along Jimmie Dyess thoroughfare
item.description: Chick-fil-A brought its latest franchise location to the CSRA, Thursday morning, at 6 a.m., introducing its new experimental drive-thru only restaurant near I-20 Exit 194. item.title: Augusta agenda includes $2 million Broad Street incentive, Eisenhower paving
item.description: Augusta commissioners will take up an incentive aimed at finishing sections of Broad Street construction early, a contract supplement to resurface Eisenhower Drive ahead of the Masters Tournament and several affordable housing items during a Tuesday meeting. The post Augusta agenda includes $2 million Broad Street incentive, Eisenhower paving appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Longtime Augusta finance official tenders resignation
item.description: Timothy E. Schroer, the longtime deputy Augusta Finance director who has served as interim director for 16 months, submitted his resignation Friday. The post Longtime Augusta finance official tenders resignation appeared first on The Augusta Press.
